The '''Repulsor-In''' was a [[Vertical]] [[Fence (swoopchasing)|Fence]]. It was the most common obstacle used on a [[swoopchasing]] course. Repulsor-Ins were simple barriers, with a height of no more than [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. The Fence had an embedded [[Repulsor field/Legends|repulsor field]] generator that rapidly drew approaching [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] towards it. Swoops heading to the Repulsor-In accelerated from two hundred and fifty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] up to speeds of four hundred kilometers an hour.<ref name="BSS" />
